assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not contain dedicated questions to record unpaid domestic and care work per person independently of main and secondary employment. Domestic and care activities are only included as response options for reasons for not seeking work, not working more hours, or resigning from a job (e.g., j7 option 3, h16 option 5, j24 option 2). Per the indicator definition, listing domestic or care work solely as a reason for not working or as a category of inactivity does not count as measuring unpaid domestic and care work.
